scope_reason: First bounded experiment in two major USD-M perpetual contracts already established before 2022; no claim about all altcoin futures or a survivor-free exchange-wide universe.
pit_policy: Neither CSV create_time nor archive LastModified alone certifies historical public availability. Retrospective data can support separately labelled lag-assumption diagnostics, not verified point-in-time profitability. No PASS without availability evidence.
rules_and_costs: Freeze after availability audit and before any strategy-return calculation; do not optimize on diagnostic returns.
